name: asset-pack
description: A consistent set of N assets from one style guide: style guide and plan (approval), the assets built with the Studio builders (2D sprites, tiles, icons, sounds; 3D models in Blender), the asset gates, an art director's consistency review from the previews (palette, scale, outline, silhouette), revisions, and a pack manifest; optionally imported into an engine.

brief.description: What the pack is for and what is in it (e.g. "5 dungeon props: barrel, crate, chest, torch, rock").

style.description: The look in a few words (empty: the art director proposes one)

engine.description: Import into this engine after: "none", "web", "godot" or "unreal"

approval.description: "manual" to approve the style guide first, "auto" to go straight on

guide.title: Style guide and pack plan

approve.title: Approve the style guide
approve.message:
The style guide and the pack plan are ready. Approve to build the pack, or send them back.

{{state.guide}}

make.title: Build the pack
make.prompt: Stage: pack-make. Build every asset in design/asset-plan.json with its tool and input, under its id. Look at each preview as it comes: off-palette colours, a wrong size or a different outline get rebuilt now. Report the ids with one line each on what you saw.

fix.title: Fix
fix.prompt:
Stage: pack-fix. The asset checks failed. Fix exactly what they name, keeping the ids and the style guide.

{{feedback}}

review.title: Consistency review
review.prompt: Stage: pack-review. Review the pack as a set, against design/style-guide.md: read every asset's preview (studio_library show, then read the preview file; images are shown) side by side. Judge palette (studio_image info: colours), scale and size (frame sizes; 3D: sizeM and triangles), outline and shading, silhouettes that read and differ, and that each asset does its purpose. Write docs/pack-review.md with findings as `- [BLOCKING|MAJOR|MINOR] asset - problem. Fix: ...`. REQUEST_CHANGES only for BLOCKING or MAJOR.

revise.title: Revise
revise.prompt:
Stage: pack-revise. Address every BLOCKING and MAJOR finding in docs/pack-review.md: rebuild those assets (same ids, changed inputs), look at the new previews, and add a "Resolution" line under each finding.

{{state.review}}

pack.title: Pack manifest and import
pack.prompt: Stage: pack-deliver. Write design/pack.json ({"name", "style", "palette", "assets": [ids]}) and docs/pack.md (a table: id, kind, purpose, size, licence). Target engine: {{input.engine}} - godot: copy the files into the project (the builders' export) and record engines.godot in each asset.json; unreal: unreal asset.import each .glb (or .fbx) into /Game/Pack; web: nothing to import (game.json names them as "asset:<id>"); none: nothing. Report the ids.
